notes.title: I/O Update
notes.content:
Another big update here! 

Very happy to introduce an improved lineup of Logic Blocks to work with:
[list]
[*]Coils added from the Ladder Toolbar now have a Set / Reset (Latch / Unlatch) option.
[*]Timers now include a Retentive option to retain the time when off.
[*]Timer Off is now available as a Timer option.
[*]A new Blink Block to act as a pulse timer. Option includes On/Off function.
[*]A new Counter Block to increment a Memory Block up or down.
[*]A new Reset Block that can be used to reset a Timer or Counter.
[/list]

Also include is a completely revised Instruction Manual to help explain all of these.

Thank you to [url=https://insightsinautomation.com/]Insights in Automation[/url] for helping get this revised I/O off the ground!

notes.title: Version 1.0.6 Update
notes.content:
[h1]Version 1.0.6[/h1]

This update is to address bugs, there are still a couple major bugs on the list which are high priority but I wanted to get this out for now.

1	Fixed crash when only one output contact and relay coil on ladder is deleted
2	Fixed remaining contacts moving to home position when changing from 3->2 state selector
3	Fixed sprite depth when deleting control panel contacts from ladder
4	Fixed crash on branch nodes in wrong position after shifting rungs (ie add/delete rung)
5	Fixed crash on delete rung with OneShot block on rung below
6	Adjusted box palletizer elevator low position to be on in default start position
7	Fixed auto-scroll to bottom when adding rung above or below from rung menu
8	Fixed MemBlock menu interfering with load/save menu confirmation pop-up

notes.title: Re-compile Update
notes.content:
This update has been re-compiled with a changed setting to hopefully address the "Ran out of GPU memory, try using smaller or fewer images" crash reported. 

If you experience any issues after this update please post in the discussion board. 

Thank you!
